 Your Under-Eyes Need SPF, Too—These Tinted Formulas Make It Easy
 Elle Follow Emma Aerin Becker Wed, November 11, 2026 at 8:32 PM UTC Add to Preferred Sources Wed, November 11, 2026 at 8:32 PM UTC Tinted SPFs for Under-Eyes To Protect and Conceal Veronique Beranger - Getty Images "Hearst Magazines and Yahoo may earn commission or revenue on some items through these links." 
 Quick Overview Colorescience Total Eye 3-in-1 Renewal Therapy SPF 35
 $79 at nordstrom.com Drmtlgy Luminous Eye Corrector SPF 41
 $44 at drmtlgy.com RMS Beauty ReFresh Eye Brightener Broad Spectrum SPF 30
 $49 at rmsbeauty.com Supergoop! Bright-Eyed 100% Mineral Eye Cream SPF 40
 $40 at sephora.com Ciele Conceal & PROTECT SPF 50+ spot concealer
 $36 at sephora.com Sunscreen is always important, but when one product can also brighten your complexion and take the place of your favorite concealer, it becomes impossible to forget. Tinted SPF offers the best of both worlds, helping protect your skin from the sun while giving it the appearance of a more even complexion. And when it's made specifically for the eye area, it can make one of the most delicate parts of your skin care routine feel a whole lot easier.
 "Tinted sunscreens are one of those rare beauty products where the cosmetic benefit and the dermatological benefit really align," says Dr. Pearl Ugwu-Dike, a board-certified dermatologist. "You're protecting your skin from tomorrow's sun damage while making it look good today." As for why they're especially useful under the eyes, the skin in that area is some of the most delicate that we have on our body. "That makes it particularly susceptible to visible signs of photoaging, like fine lines, crepiness, hyperpigmentation," Dr. Ugwu-Dike says. "It's also often a place that gets neglected when applying sunscreen, conventionally." That's why the best tinted SPFs for under-eyes are so special: They offer protection while providing immediate color correction and a brighter-looking appearance, helping to camouflage under-eye bags and dark circles.
 Preview the Best Tinted SPFs for Under-Eyes of 2026
 Best Overall: Colorescience Total Eye 3-in-1 Renewal Therapy SPF 35 , $79
 Best Pigmentation: Drmtlgy Luminous Eye Corrector SPF 41 , $44
 Best Color Correcting: RMS Beauty ReFresh Eye Brightener Broad Spectrum SPF 30 , $49
 Advertisement Advertisement Of course, the right formula depends on how much coverage you want, your skin type, and how your under-eye area tends to behave throughout the day. Some options are transparent and brightening, while others can pull double duty as a true concealer. Ahead, we've rounded up the best tinted SPFs for under-eyes so you can find the one that fits seamlessly into your morning routine.
 1) Colorescience Total Eye 3-in-1 Renewal Therapy SPF 35
 Colorescience Total Eye 3-in-1 Renewal Therapy SPF 35 
 Save This is what happens when an eye cream, sunscreen, and concealer all decide to overachieve. "I love that it addresses two of my biggest concerns with the under-eye area, which are pigmentation and photoaging," says Dr. Pearl Ugwu-Dike , an NYC-based board-certified dermatologist. "I also really like that it combines peptides, hyaluronic acid, and a cooling applicator."
 Shades: 4
 Key ingredients: Titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, hyaluronic acid, peptides
 Customer review: "This is a wonderful product! Skin care, SPF, and even color corrector in one. It goes on smoothly, does not crease, does not sting the eyes. The peachy color gives a natural concealing effect. I can't recommend this enough." 
 Pros Combines eye cream, sunscreen, and concealer
 Cons Applicator dispenses too much product
 $79 at nordstrom.com 2) Drmtlgy Luminous Eye Corrector SPF 41
 Drmtlgy Luminous Eye Corrector SPF 41 
 Save This product is for anyone who wants their under-eye area to look like they just got eight hours of sleep followed by a facial. "The formulation is really smart," says Dr. Ugwu-Dike. It contains both zinc oxide and titanium dioxide, along with snow mushroom, peptides, ceramides, and sodium PCA. "The snow mushroom is going to act like a humectant, which is particularly helpful in the delicate skin on the eye area where dehydration can exaggerate fine lines," she adds.
 Shades: 4
 Key ingredients: Titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, snow mushroom, peptides, ceramides, sodium PCA
 Customer review: "This eye corrector feels great going on and covers dark circles very well. Love it and plan to keep purchasing it in the future." 
 Pros Great for anti-aging and intense coverage
 Cons Easy to overdo coverage
 $44 at drmtlgy.com 3) RMS Beauty ReFresh Eye Brightener Broad Spectrum SPF 30
 RMS Beauty ReFresh Eye Brightener Broad Spectrum SPF 30 
 Save Some days you get eight hours of sleep, and other days you need a very convincing color corrector. This formula from RMS "relies on sheer, peachy undertones to neutralize the appearance of darkness while allowing skin to look like skin," says Dr. Ugwu-Dike. "I also really like that it includes caffeine and coffee seed extract in the formula that might temporarily improve the appearance of puffiness."
 Shades: 4
 Key ingredients: Zinc oxide, caffeine, coffee seed extract
 Customer review: "Love this eye cream. It makes the entire eye area look better. I use it every day, and it covers beautifully—no need for concealer over it. It lasts all day. My eyes are very sensitive and this does not bother them at all." 
 $49 at rmsbeauty.com 4) Supergoop! Bright-Eyed 100% Mineral Eye Cream SPF 40
 Supergoop! Bright-Eyed 100% Mineral Eye Cream SPF 40 
 Save "I think this formula is perfect for someone who doesn't necessarily have substantial pigmentation under the eyes, but wants to improve a tired or dull appearance," says Dr. Ugwu-Dike. The lightweight formula approaches under-eye darkness through illumination rather than heavy coverage, delivering a bright appearance that's never cakey. It also has caffeine for de-puffing and green tea extract for soothing.
 Shades: 1
 Key ingredients: Titanium dioxide, zinc oxide, snow mushroom, peptides, ceramides, sodium PCA
 Customer review: "I've been using this for nearly a year now and it is my holy grail product! It glides on well for me - no pilling. My skin leans towards dry and sensitive. I've never had any issues with this eye cream. I use it in the morning and it brightens beautifully. It acts great as a primer. On no-makeup days, it brightens me up!" 
 Pros Great for dull or tired eyes
 Cons Only one shade
 $40 at sephora.com 5) Ciele Conceal & PROTECT SPF 50+ spot concealer
 Ciele Conceal & PROTECT SPF 50+ spot concealer 
 Save While most products on this list are SPF eye creams with a tint, Ciele flipped the narrative. This formula puts concealer first, infusing the highly pigmented makeup product with SPF 50+. Place it under the eyes or on your blemishes to keep them both hidden and protected.
 Shades: 20
 Key ingredients: Tranexamic acid, zinc oxide, titanium dioxide
 Customer review: "My absolute favorite concealer. There's nothing else out there like it—only formula I feel comfortable putting on blemishes knowing it will conceal (won't budge!), treat, and protect with SPF. It's better than any spot treatment I could have found." 
 Pros Large shade range
 Cons Some find it patchy
 $36 at sephora.com Meet the Experts
 Dr. Pearl Ugwu-Dike is a board-certified dermatologist based in New York City.
